verdict.rationale: Convex's first-party docs describe built-in vector search over Convex documents whose vectors are typically embeddings of text, images, or audio, aimed at giving LLMs context for AI apps and recommendations. The docs also cover vector indexes with additional filter fields, and pricing lists vector search on the Free & Starter tier. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented detail on index definition (dimensions, similarity metric) and scale limits.
